summary.text: Meredith McGinnis is the Democratic candidate for Oklahoma State Senate District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Tyler Herring (R).
She is an attorney who is corporate counsel for a regional real estate company, according to a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Meredith McGinnis graduated from Putnam City West High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma in 2009, and received a law degree from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 2012.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, McGinnis described herself as an attorney, mother of three, boxer, poultry breeder and community advocate who is licensed in multiple states and federal courts.

She said she received the OKC Public School Foundation Volunteer of the Year award in 2024 for directing a high school food pantry on behalf of her church, and that she was the 2026 Oklahoma-Kansas Golden Gloves regional boxing champion.
She also said she volunteers at Mabel Bassett Correctional Center, serves on the board of a criminal justice organization, and is a Boy Scout den leader.
McGinnis said in the survey that improving Oklahoma schools is her top priority, and she also called for affordable healthcare, including mental health, addiction and postpartum care.
